title: 9 Psalms a Godly Man Reads When He Can't Sleep
caption:
It's 1 AM. Your mind won't shut off, and your hand is already reaching for the phone.

The Psalms were written by men who couldn't sleep either. Running from enemies. Wrecked by their own sin. Afraid of tomorrow.

Keep a Bible on the nightstand and the phone in the kitchen. Pick the Psalm that matches the night.

“He gives to his beloved sleep.” Psalm 127:2

Save this for the next 1 AM.
